items.prompt: A short backtest has a high annualized ratio and low measured drawdown. What would you still check?
items.modelAnswer: Return/flow/cost/mark/denominator conventions, sample length and grid, zero/stale volatility, serial dependence/annualization assumptions, selection bias and independent out-of-sample performance. Historical drawdown is no future bound, and a ratio does not establish tradability.
